Class Message

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.it.network.message.Message
public class Message extends Object
Network message: a type string + a JSON payload. Serialised as a single JSON line: {"type":"PLACE_TOTEM","playerName":"Alice","tileLetter":"B"} One class replaces all record subtypes — no Jackson, no multiple files. Uses org.json which is already in the project dependencies.

    • leaderboard

      public static Message leaderboard(String recipient, int myScore, int myRank, int totalEntries, int numPlayers, List<LeaderboardEntry> leaderboard)
      Builds a personalised message for one player
      Parameters:
      recipient - nickname of the player this message is addressed to
      myScore - final score the recipient obtained in this game
      myRank - 1-based rank of the recipient among all games of the same size (use -1 if unknown)
      totalEntries - total number of recorded scores for that size
      numPlayers - number of players the game had
      leaderboard - full leaderboard for the given game size
